{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] red [[Cookbook:Wine vinegar|wine vinegar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], smashed and minced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) leg of [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]] (shank end), cut into 1½ inch cubes

== Special equipment ==

* Soaked bamboo [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewers]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except lamb in a gallon size zip-top bag. Add lamb cubes and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat; refrigerate overnight to [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]].
#The next day, drain lamb and discard marinade. 
#Thread 4 lamb cubes onto one skewer. Repeat until all lamb has been skewered.
#Fire up a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] for 15 minutes. Add lamb and cook 8 minutes per side for medium rare. 
#Serve warm with couscous.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The vinegar will not turn the lamb into mush as it is not acidic enough to tenderize.
